_about: Starting values for how risks are rated (15 Nov 2026). These are the starting values. Tech Risk changes them on the site (Edit, Rating settings), and a saved change wins over this file. What was picked and why: docs/design/19_risk_rating.md.
_medium_share_above: A risk that is not Critical or High is Medium when more than this share of its likelihood drivers is on. 0.30 means one driver of three.
_elevated: A risk is Elevated when its likelihood AND its impact are both at or above these levels (proposed; to confirm with the Head of Tech Risk).
